description: Cluster infrastructure health: current node risks, telemetry coverage, host trends, capacity and physical networking. Open kube-workload for application availability, container resources, traffic and logs. Missing data is never a healthy zero.

targets.expr: sum(kube_node_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_group=~"$label_group"})

sum(kube_pod_info{cluster=~"$cluster"} * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_group=~"$label_group"}) /
sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource=~"pods"} * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_group=~"$label_group"}) * 100

sum((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource=~"cpu"} or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource=~"cpu"} and on(cluster,namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_init_container_status_running == 1))) * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_group=~"$label_group"}) /
sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource=~"cpu"} * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_group=~"$label_group"}) * 100

sum((kube_pod_container_resource_requests{resource=~"memory"} or (kube_pod_init_container_resource_requests{resource=~"memory"} and on(cluster,namespace,pod,container) (kube_pod_init_container_status_running == 1))) * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_group=~"$label_group"}) /
sum(kube_node_status_allocatable{resource=~"memory"} * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_group=~"$label_group"}) * 100

panels.title: Memory Requests / Allocatable
panels.description: Scheduling reservation only. Kernel memory, page cache, and usage above requests are not represented.

targets.expr: sum(kube_node_spec_unschedulable{cluster=~"$cluster"} * on (cluster, node) group_left (role) kube_node_labels{cluster=~"$cluster",label_group=~"$label_group"})

panels.title: Cordoned Nodes
panels.description: Unschedulable nodes, not a readiness or connectivity check.

panels.title: Max Host CPU Busy
panels.description: Worst node CPU busy percentage. CPU pressure and load trends are shown below.

targets.expr: max(100 * (1 - avg by(cluster,instance)(rate(node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",mode="idle"}[2m]))))

panels.title: Max Host Memory Used
panels.description: Worst measured host memory usage, including kernel memory. Check failed targets before treating absent node data as recovery.

targets.expr: 100 - (min(100 * max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}) / max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})))

panels.title: Max Kernel / RAM
panels.description: Includes kernel BPF map allocations. Sustained growth can exhaust a node while pod memory looks normal.

targets.expr: max(100 * max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_VmallocUsed_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}) / max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}))

panels.title: Max Writable Disk Used
panels.description: Worst writable root/data filesystem usage; readonly OS images are excluded.

targets.expr: max(max by (cluster, instance) (100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",mountpoint=~"/|/local"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",mountpoint=~"/|/local"}) and on(cluster,instance,device,mountpoint) (node_filesystem_readonly{cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",mountpoint=~"/|/local"} == 0)))

panels.title: Failed Targets (5m)
panels.description: Core monitoring targets with at least one failed scrape in the last 5 minutes; this is not the number of nodes.

targets.expr: sum(max by(cluster,job,instance,metrics_path) (1 - min_over_time(up{cluster=~"$cluster",job=~"node-exporter|kubelet|apiserver|kube-state-metrics"}[5m])))

panels.title: Restarts (10m)
panels.description: Cluster-wide count across all namespaces. A last termination reason of Completed does not hide a liveness restart.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (cluster, node) ((increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[10m]) or increase(kube_pod_init_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[10m])) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left(node) max by (cluster, namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{cluster=~"$cluster"})))

panels.title: Liveness Fails (5m)
panels.description: Failed liveness checks in the last 5 minutes. Zero is supplied only for a successfully scraped kubelet probes endpoint.

targets.expr: sum(sum by (cluster, instance) (increase(prober_probe_total{cluster=~"$cluster",probe_type="Liveness",result="failed"}[5m])) or on (cluster, instance) (0 * max by (cluster, instance) (up{cluster=~"$cluster",job="kubelet",metrics_path="/metrics/probes"} == 1)))

panels.title: Nodes Not Ready
panels.description: Ready can remain true during a short node stall; also inspect host memory, PSI, and scrape failures.

targets.expr: sum(kube_node_status_condition{cluster=~"$cluster",condition="Ready",status=~"false|unknown"})

panels.title: Nodes needing attention — current values
panels.description: Sort by memory usage to identify the affected instance. Host metrics remain available independently of kube-state-metrics.

targets.expr: (100 - (100 * max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}) / max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}))) * on(cluster,instance) group_left(node) group by(cluster,instance,node)(up{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})

(100 * max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_VmallocUsed_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}) / max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})) * on(cluster,instance) group_left(node) group by(cluster,instance,node)(up{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})

(max by (cluster, instance) (node_load1{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}) / count by (cluster, instance) (max by (cluster, instance, cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",mode="idle"}))) * on(cluster,instance) group_left(node) group by(cluster,instance,node)(up{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})

(max by (cluster, instance) (100 * rate(node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}[2m]))) * on(cluster,instance) group_left(node) group by(cluster,instance,node)(up{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})

100 * max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_MemAvailable_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}) / max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Kernel Vmalloc by Instance
panels.description: Kernel virtual allocations backed by memory, including BPF hash maps. Look for growth across hours or days; not equivalent to pod RSS.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_VmallocUsed_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Memory / I/O Stall Time (PSI)
panels.description: Percentage of wall time with tasks stalled on memory or I/O. Missing PSI is not a zero.

targets.expr: 100 * max by (cluster, instance) (rate(node_pressure_memory_waiting_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}[2m]))
100 * max by (cluster, instance) (rate(node_pressure_io_waiting_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}[2m]))

panels.title: Swap In / Out by Instance
panels.description: Pages per second. Swap activity can indicate host pressure even when Kubernetes MemoryPressure stays false.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, instance) (rate(node_vmstat_pswpin{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}[2m]))
max by (cluster, instance) (rate(node_vmstat_pswpout{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}[2m]))

panels.title: Load per CPU Core
panels.description: Runnable and uninterruptible tasks per CPU core; includes I/O waits, unlike CPU utilization.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, instance) (node_load1{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}) / count by (cluster, instance) (max by (cluster, instance, cpu) (node_cpu_seconds_total{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",mode="idle"}))

sum by (cluster, instance) (increase(prober_probe_total{cluster=~"$cluster",probe_type="Liveness",result="failed"}[5m])) or on (cluster, instance) (0 * max by (cluster, instance) (up{cluster=~"$cluster",job="kubelet",metrics_path="/metrics/probes"} == 1))

panels.title: Core Target Scrape Health
panels.description: 1 = successful scrape, 0 = failure, gap = missing samples. Includes both API servers and worker monitoring endpoints.

targets.expr: min by(cluster,job,instance,metrics_path) (up{cluster=~"$cluster",job=~"node-exporter|kubelet|apiserver|kube-state-metrics"})

sum by (cluster, node) ((increase(kube_pod_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[10m]) or increase(kube_pod_init_container_status_restarts_total{cluster=~"$cluster"}[10m])) * on (cluster, namespace, pod) group_left(node) max by (cluster, namespace, pod, node) (kube_pod_info{cluster=~"$cluster"}))

100 * max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_VmallocUsed_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}) / max by (cluster, instance) (node_memory_MemTotal_bytes{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Major Page Faults by Instance
panels.description: Major faults per second require fetching pages; correlate with swap activity and memory PSI.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, instance) (rate(node_vmstat_pgmajfault{job="node-exporter",cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance"}[2m]))

panels.title: Writable Root / Local Disk Used
panels.description: Worst writable root/data filesystem per node; readonly OS images are excluded.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, instance) (100 * (1 - node_filesystem_avail_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",mountpoint=~"/|/local"} / node_filesystem_size_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",mountpoint=~"/|/local"}) and on(cluster,instance,device,mountpoint) (node_filesystem_readonly{cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",mountpoint=~"/|/local"} == 0))

panels.title: Physical Network I/O
panels.description: Physical interfaces only; pod veth interfaces are excluded to avoid counting traffic twice.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, instance) (max by (cluster, instance, device) (rate(node_network_receive_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",device=~"eth[0-9]+|en[opsx].*"}[2m])))
sum by (cluster, instance) (max by (cluster, instance, device) (rate(node_network_transmit_bytes_total{cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",device=~"eth[0-9]+|en[opsx].*"}[2m])))

sum by (cluster, instance) (max by (cluster, instance, device) (rate(node_network_receive_errs_total{cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",device=~"eth[0-9]+|en[opsx].*"}[2m]))) + sum by (cluster, instance) (max by (cluster, instance, device) (rate(node_network_transmit_errs_total{cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",device=~"eth[0-9]+|en[opsx].*"}[2m])))

sum by (cluster, instance) (max by (cluster, instance, device) (rate(node_network_receive_drop_total{cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",device=~"eth[0-9]+|en[opsx].*"}[2m]))) + sum by (cluster, instance) (max by (cluster, instance, device) (rate(node_network_transmit_drop_total{cluster=~"$cluster",instance=~"$instance",device=~"eth[0-9]+|en[opsx].*"}[2m])))

title: Kubernetes Cluster - Prometheus
